decisions.reason: After two years without website presence, this fairly undifferentiated bread likely failed to stay above aspiration or was absorbed into the standard assortment, so management would release the resources.

The tour fits the heritage offer, but its absence from the website through the disrupted 2020–2021 period suggests results stayed too uncertain relative to aspiration for a medium-range firm to carry it.
A sweet pastry is close to the core business, yet repeated non-observation points to weak distinctiveness or sub-aspiration sales, making it a plausible candidate for pruning.

This farmhouse bread is tightly aligned with existing bakery capabilities and there is no direct negative signal after launch, so boundedly rational management would usually continue it unless clear underperformance appears.
As a flagship seasonal product with its own page and a gold award, this stollen likely exceeds aspiration and attracts commitment, so management would strongly favor retention.
The premium stollen also carries a gold award and fits the established festive range, so in a growing industry it is likely to be kept unless later evidence shows a meaningful shortfall.
